contraction_budgets.direction: budgets may only decrease as deletion leaves land; [1319-B7] retired the Shell runtime (shell_ops/, tachi_shell facade, TachiShellParams) and replaced it with the minimal tachi_staff facade delegating to the canonical staffing_ops contract (E1). [1319-C2] removed the tachi_task Dispatch arm (and its TachiDispatchParams rebuild), the dispatch_reason + inject_card fields, and the wait/cancel actions — dropping the Task dispatch adopter/builder and removing tachi_task from launch_advertising_facades. [1319-D1] removed the no-real-authority Arena actions (open/abort/close/reap) and collect's linked-result COPY (now returns a canonical result.md reference without copying), and stopped Arena's standalone board.json write — board now reads canonical state. [1319-D2] deleted the Arena facade entirely (tachi_arena route, TachiArenaParams, arena_ops/, the arena probe, the arena-root env guard, and all mission prompt/status/result copies): the canonical replacements already existed (tachi_staff(start) for spawn, tachi_task(board) for board, Task submit / canonical result ref for collect). launch_advertising_facades dropped 1→0 (tachi_arena was the last launcher); production_adopters 3→2; request_builders 4→3; legacy_secondary_ledger_roots 2→1 (arena_root removed) then 1→0 in [1319-E2] (shell_runs_root renamed flow_runs_root — the canonical runs root is no longer Shell-owned, so the census path rule no longer miscounts it as a legacy owner); legacy_staffing_projection_writer_sites 11→6 (all arena sites gone); the tachi_arena and tachi_shell legacy_debt entries retired (the shell_runs_root rename in [1319-E2] retires the last Shell-name debt: the canonical runs root is now named flow_runs_root).
